question: Which of the following enzymes are essential of DNA replication in an animal cell?

options.text: Topoisomerase, DNA ligase, DNA polymerase, DNA primase
Reverse transcriptase, DNA polymerase, DNA primase

solution:
The correct answer is __**Topoisomerase, DNA ligase, DNA polymerase, DNA primase**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Topoisomerase, DNA ligase, DNA polymerase, DNA primase** are essential enzymes involved in the process of DNA replication in an animal cell.
 
• **Topoisomerase** helps in relieving the tension generated during the unwinding of the DNA helix.
 
• **DNA ligase**
